answer: Identity earns a dock in the harbor only if it is measurably distinct. Each epoch the beacon samples docks with timing probes; latency and egress signatures are compared, and any pair whose fingerprint delta sits under the cluster threshold is merged: the cluster shares one emission until it proves durable divergence. A farm reselling 900 clones through 40 datacenter routes coalesces into 40 payout sinks, so each head earns 1/22nd of a solo dock while rent stays per-head. Faking 900 stable signatures costs more than the farm collects, and the beacon rotates its sampling, so camouflage decays.
